capability_candidates.capability: Portable harness abstraction and runtime swapping
capability_candidates.rationale: FA3 Agent Workload Runtime is provider-neutral, but no single universal harness descriptor/contract exists

capability_candidates.capability: Harness capability declaration and feature matrix
capability_candidates.rationale: Model capability descriptors exist; harness capabilities are not a canonical normalized descriptor

capability_candidates.capability: Declarative portable agent specification independent of harness
capability_candidates.rationale: Typed workload/task/execution-plan contracts exist; portable agent-to-harness manifest is not unified

capability_candidates.capability: Contextual policy composition with ALLOW/ASK/DENY
capability_candidates.rationale: UAF has external authorization and explicit approval; #557 draft is intended authority guard

capability_candidates.capability: Sub-agent creation and bounded multi-agent delegation
capability_candidates.rationale: Agent Federation, runtime transfer budgets and UAF mediation already cover bounded delegation

capability_candidates.capability: Persistent session continuity across harness/client surfaces
capability_candidates.rationale: FA3 has session integrity and durable workload resume, but lacks a universal client-agent session compatibility contract

capability_candidates.capability: Separate placement environment from OS access confinement
capability_candidates.rationale: HRB owns where/resources; FA3 Agent Sandbox owns filesystem/network confinement

capability_candidates.capability: Fail when requested sandbox cannot be supplied
capability_candidates.rationale: FA3 mandatory sandbox is fail-closed and host subprocess arbitrary agent execution is denied

capability_candidates.capability: MCP subprocess outside primary OS sandbox
capability_candidates.rationale: Omnigent documents MCP subprocesses outside its OS sandbox; FA3 target requires canonical mediation and full execution containment

capability_candidates.capability: Per-harness conformance/capability test bench
capability_candidates.rationale: Provider/model assurance exists, but no harness-specific conformance matrix/gate

capability_candidates.capability: Optional ACP-backed custom harness registration
capability_candidates.rationale: ACP is not yet an explicit FA3 compatibility surface

capability_candidates.capability: Client creates and resumes agent sessions
capability_candidates.rationale: Workload start/resume and session integrity exist; ACP session/new/resume mapping does not

capability_candidates.capability: Permission requests with cancellation semantics
capability_candidates.rationale: UAF approval is digest-bound and fail-closed; ACP request_permission/cancel transport semantics are absent

capability_candidates.capability: Client/agent capability negotiation
capability_candidates.rationale: No ACP capability negotiation projection exists

capability_candidates.capability: Streaming progress/session updates
capability_candidates.rationale: FA3 has journal/control-center projections but no ACP wire projection

capability_candidates.capability: AgentCard capability advertisement/discovery
capability_candidates.rationale: FA3 Federation exists, but no standard AgentCard projection; advertised capability must remain untrusted

capability_candidates.capability: Stateful task lifecycle for remote agents
capability_candidates.rationale: FA3 Federation + Agent Workload Task + Temporal already provide stateful bounded execution semantics

capability_candidates.capability: Message and Artifact are distinct protocol objects
capability_candidates.rationale: FA3 has artifacts/provenance, but A2A-compatible communication-output separation is not explicit

capability_candidates.capability: Streaming task status and artifact updates
capability_candidates.rationale: FA3 has lifecycle/journal projection but no A2A stream binding

capability_candidates.capability: Resubscribe/push notification for long-running disconnected tasks
capability_candidates.rationale: Temporal/event-driven work exists; A2A transport binding is absent

capability_candidates.capability: Deferred tool/action requests with later supplied results
capability_candidates.rationale: FA3 has pause/checkpoint and approval but no generic typed deferred-action lifecycle

capability_candidates.capability: Human approval represented as a deferred tool state
capability_candidates.rationale: Approval exists; explicit deferred-state coupling is missing

capability_candidates.capability: Pluggable durability backends for agent runs
capability_candidates.rationale: FA3 already assigns sole global durable lifecycle authority to Temporal

capability_candidates.capability: Stable tool identity across wrappers/MCP/deferred/durable execution
capability_candidates.rationale: UAF action IDs and MCP mediation exist; cross-wrapper stable identity invariant is not explicit

capability_candidates.capability: Interrupt and resume from persisted graph state
capability_candidates.rationale: FA3 workload resume/checkpoint plus Temporal authority already materialized

capability_candidates.capability: Checkpoint-aware nested/subgraph resume semantics
capability_candidates.rationale: FA3 supports bounded agent transfer and checkpoint resume, but nested checkpoint inheritance semantics are not explicit

capability_candidates.capability: Checkpoint captures pending approval/session state
capability_candidates.rationale: FA3 checkpoint validation and approvals exist separately; explicit pending-approval checkpoint binding is not proven

capability_candidates.capability: Per-user/session storage isolation and strict resume identity
capability_candidates.rationale: FA3 session/thread integrity exists; storage-scope isolation should be made explicit for interoperability

capability_candidates.capability: Cancel selected pending external requests and unwind nested correlation
capability_candidates.rationale: Cancellation exists, but targeted nested pending-request cancellation semantics are not normalized

capability_candidates.capability: Principal-Action-Resource-Context authorization envelope
capability_candidates.rationale: FA3 has scoped actions/identity/context; #557 draft is the natural insertion point

capability_candidates.capability: Forbid precedence and default-deny authorization evaluation
capability_candidates.rationale: FA3 is broadly fail-closed; formal cross-policy precedence is not yet a universal contract

capability_candidates.capability: GenAI semantic convention export for agents/tools/model usage
capability_candidates.rationale: No canonical OpenTelemetry GenAI adapter found

capability_candidates.capability: Conversation/tool/token/model operation attributes
capability_candidates.rationale: FA3 internal evidence/journal fields exist, but no standard GenAI semantic-convention projection

capability_candidates.capability: Agent identity separated from multiple conversations
capability_candidates.rationale: FA3 has agent/session concepts, but canonical Run/Session/Memory/Evidence ownership split is not explicit in one contract

capability_candidates.capability: Shareable memory blocks across agents
capability_candidates.rationale: FA3 already has governed memory; donor pattern is useful only through existing Memory Governance

capability_candidates.capability: Crash-safe resume and append-only execution trajectory
capability_candidates.rationale: Existing FA3 OpenHands enforcement explicitly requires crash-safe resume, append-only trajectory and replay without side-effect reexecution

capability_candidates.capability: ACP-capable external agent integration
capability_candidates.rationale: OpenHands upstream supports ACP-related settings, but FA3 lacks the common ACP adapter contract

capability_candidates.capability: Durable workflow lifecycle, signals, retries and cancellation
capability_candidates.rationale: Temporal is already the sole FA3 global durable lifecycle authority

capability_candidates.capability: Long-running human approval wait without losing workflow state
capability_candidates.rationale: FA3 already binds durable approvals/workflow lifecycle to Temporal; donor strengthens implementation guidance
